gloss_en: Wants a high-level Python API to create, position and update IfcOpeningElement in walls/slabs, for automated MEP tools.
title_original: [Feature Request] IfcOpenShell API: Headless Parametric Opening Creation for Walls and Slabs
question_paraphrase: Request for reusable API that calculates opening geometry, orientation and host penetration, instead of every app reimplementing it on low-level add_feature.
answer_summary: Open; low-level add_feature exists but no high-level helper.

gloss_en: Wants parametric opening objects that snap to pipe/duct centerlines, with clearance offsets, fire rating metadata, batch generation from clashes.
title_original: Feature Request: Parametric Openings for MEP Penetrations (Walls, Slabs, Roofs) With new gizmos
question_paraphrase: Dedicated penetration tool: host-aware placement, associative update when MEP moves, clearance offsets, batch from clash scan, metadata like fire rating and sealing.
context_given: ducts, pipes, cable trays through walls/slabs/roofs
phrasing_notes: bullet list of wishes; says manual creation is error-prone
answer_summary: Closed; related work on openings API tracked separately.

gloss_en: Cannot make a NEW opening in an EXISTING wall; status filters do not hide the new void in existing-state drawings.

answer_summary: Void is always applied regardless of status; workaround is duplicating the wall per phase.

gloss_en: Openings present in the STEP file but Bonsai does not show orphan ones; wants a toggle.

question_paraphrase: Openings exist in STEP but cannot be accessed because Bonsai only shows openings connected to a product.
answer_summary: Closed as invalid IFC: an opening not related to a product violates the spec; use Alt-O to toggle openings of connected products.

gloss_en: Which IFC class for a roof drain opening/scupper in a structural model; is ProvisionForVoid the opening or a reservation.

answer_summary: Proxy with PROVISIONFORVOID for requests, IfcOpeningElement for the real opening; alternatives IfcWasteTerminal ROOFDRAIN, IfcDiscreteAccessory.

gloss_en: Why are IfcOpeningElements not created for IfcBeams; is it restricted by MVD?

answer_summary: Beams may be voided; only IfcReinforcingElement prohibits voids; CV2.0 Beam_02 has them.
